reviews.comment: Dr. Halim is a fair professor. Her exams are directly from slides and are open book. You may feel bored in the class as she covers lots of slides per day, but nothing so difficult. She needs to give more homework (e.g. weekly) to keep students active and ready for exams. She gives 6-7 quizzes and drops the lowest 2. There is a group term paper.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Between the horribly worded test questions and the deceitful grading practices, I would never take another course from this instructor again. I even changed my whole degree plan to avoid doing so.

Take digital notes - prepare to go through 20-50 slides per class. Lectures were recorded though, making it great to go back and get any notes you missed. Group project is a 20-50 pg paper, but overall not bad. HW also done in groups. She goes really fast in lecture, but is so kind and willing to explain anything outside of class. Great prof!

Dr. Halim was very kind and accessible. She responded quickly to emails and was easy to reach during office hours. Her class was very straightforward with regular homework and quizzes and tests that came straight from lecture notes. She always gave examples in lectures and recorded lectures so they were easy to go back and watch whenever.
